question: Has the collective discussed Diginex's path to profitability given the M&A spend?

beat.line: Two point two million came from deal diligence and legal work — about twenty-seven percent of the increase.
beat.headline: 27% ONE-OFF
beat.action: A shaded wedge slides across the tall bar, cutting a marked slice that stays lit.

sources: In H1 FY25 (six months to September 2025), general and administrative expenses climbed $3.4M to $8.1M, with $2.2M of that driven by M&A due diligence and legal work.
That's roughly 27% of the G&A increase attributable to one-time integration costs — meaningful, but not catastrophic.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: deep magenta. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: the tall bar; a shaded paper wedge.
Opens on the tall bar, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: A shaded wedge slides across the tall bar, cutting a marked slice that stays lit.
Ends holding on the wedge.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "27% ONE-OFF".

COPY LIST: "27% ONE-OFF". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Two point two million came from deal diligence and legal work — about twenty-seven percent of the increase.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage with refined 2D motion design. The scene opens as <Picture 1>, featuring a flat, matte deep magenta background. At the center, a tall vertical bar made of black halftone photographic paper with rough white torn-paper edges extends upward. A cream-colored paper chip with rough white torn edges is taped to the top of the bar with a small piece of semi-transparent matte tape; the chip bears the extra-bold black sans-serif text "G&A $8.1M". The lighting is consistent from the upper-left, casting a small, soft paper-layer shadow beneath the chip and the bar. Immediately, the "G&A $8.1M" chip is swapped out for a new cream paper chip that reads "27% ONE-OFF" in the same bold black typography. Simultaneously, a shaded grey paper wedge, also featuring rough white torn edges, slides rapidly from left to right across the black bar with a slight overshoot before landing stably. As the wedge moves, it "cuts" a slice of the bar, leaving a distinct, lighter-shaded segment behind it that remains highlighted. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout the 5 seconds. Toward the end, the wedge and the highlighted slice hold a clear reading window, with a very subtle, rhythmic pulsing motion of the paper elements to create a loop. A narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says: <d>[English] Two point two million came from deal diligence and legal work — about twenty-seven percent of the increase.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the narrator's voice. Beneath the dialogue, crisp, tactile foley sounds are heard: a sharp paper-slap as the wedge lands and the subtle, sticky sound of tape being pressed onto a surface.
